title: Weddle schemes
summary: The classical Weddle surface is the locus of vertices of quadric cones through six points in $\mathbb{P}^3$ in linear general position. Equivalently, it is the closure of the locus of centers of projection from which those six points map to six points on a plane conic. Motivated by this 1850 construction of T. Weddle, we introduce $d$-Weddle schemes for finite point sets $Z\subset \mathbb{P}^n$, defined by an analogous projection-to-degree-$d$ condition.
